description: This file implements the AdoNetClusteringTable class, which manages membership data in an Orleans cluster using ADO.NET for database operations. It provides methods for reading, inserting, updating, and deleting membership entries, along with initialization and cleanup routines. The class communicates with a relational database, executing queries via an Orleans-specific RelationalOrleansQueries helper.

classes.name: AdoNetClusteringTable
classes.description: A class responsible for managing Orleans cluster membership information in a relational database using ADO.NET. Implements IMembershipTable to support operations such as reading, inserting, updating, and deleting membership data, as well as initializing and cleaning up the membership table.

methods.name: InitializeMembershipTable
methods.description: Initializes the membership table by setting up necessary database queries and optionally inserting the initial version row.

methods.name: ReadRow
methods.description: Reads a specific membership entry identified by a SiloAddress key.

methods.name: ReadAll
methods.description: Retrieves all membership entries for the current cluster.

methods.name: InsertRow
methods.description: Inserts a new membership entry into the database, given a MembershipEntry and TableVersion.

methods.name: UpdateRow
methods.description: Updates an existing membership entry with an etag and TableVersion.

methods.name: UpdateIAmAlive
methods.description: Updates the IAmAlive timestamp for a given membership entry.

methods.name: DeleteMembershipTableEntries
methods.description: Deletes all membership entries associated with the specified cluster ID.

methods.name: CleanupDefunctSiloEntries
methods.description: Removes defunct silo entries that are older than a specified date.

methods.name: InitTableAsync
methods.description: Initializes the membership version row in the database.
